claims.exact_statement: For every fixed q in (0,1/2), the genuine Boolean gate g(x,y)=(-1)^(xy), with P(X=1)=p, P(Y=1)=q and physical reveal A={X}, satisfies (J_A-M_A)/(p log_2(1/p)) -> 4q(1-2q) as p->0+. In particular at q=1/4 the limit is 1/2, so any p-only correction valid uniformly over all other biases and Boolean gates is not O(p).
proof_dependencies: definitions of M_A and J_A from original B09 report
claims.supersedes: original B09 REPORT.md section 5(4) unsupported endpoint-optimality inference
claims.refutes: existence of an O(p) correction epsilon(p) valid for all Boolean gates and all other product biases

claims.exact_statement: For f(x,y)=f_1(x)f_2(y) on disjoint variables and aligned reveal A=A_1 union A_2, the product-biased spectral law and every physical child law tensorize; consequently M,J,L and Delta add. No such additivity is claimed for arbitrary Boolean composition F(g_1,...,g_k).
claims.supersedes: original B09 REPORT.md section 5 broad composition wording
claims.first_unproved_line: Any transfer of the M,J ledger through nonmultiplicative Boolean composition remains unproved here.
